title: /review 用法提示给出未被 parser 识别的 perf 维度名
trigger: 普通 TUI usage 明示 --dimensions=security,perf,...；用户输入 security,perf 或 perf，handler 把 flag 值直接交给 parseDimensions。
expected: 所提示的 perf 选中性能维度，且与其他有效维度组合时不被静默丢弃。
actual: actual leaf parseDimensions("security,perf") returns ["security"]; perf alone falls back to ALL_DIMENSIONS. Actual built prompts omit performance in the mixed case and list all four dimension choices in the perf-only JSON case. Canonical performance controls stay scoped correctly.
contract: The bug is the help/parser contradiction, not the documented behavior for arbitrary unknown names. Existing archive example uses security,performance.
runtimeScope: Actual production leaf parser and prompt builder only; owned strings; no CLI/client/Git/model/TUI render execution.
consumerEvidence: Static selected TUI handler, registry listCommands, App commandDefs pass-through, CommandInput inline hint usage.
dedup: All-history docs/bugs Markdown and recursive JSON values searched; exact reviewed contexts are architecture/archive/inventory, no same help/parser mismatch finding found. Pattern index is not exhaustive semantic proof.
fixDirection: Change usage to performance, or deliberately support/test perf as an alias.
